title: How to Build Digital Humans? From Priors to Photorealistic Avatars
On the Skinning of Gaussian Avatars
abstract: Radiance field-based methods have recently been used to reconstruct human avatars, showing that we can significantly downscale the systems needed for creating animated human avatars. With Gaussian splatting overcoming the challenges of slow rendering and backward mapping, a new family of approaches has emerged. However, the linear blend skinning required for the deformation of the Gaussians does not provide valid results for their non-linear rotation properties. This work addresses such artifacts in Gaussian avatar skinning.
